philippines.title: Edcom: Negros lost most school days to natural hazards from 2024 to 2026
philippines.description:
BACOLOD CITY—The Negros Island Region lost an average of 26 school days per division to natural hazards and calamities from 2024 to 2026, the highest recorded in the country during the period, according to the Second Congressional Commission on Education (Edcom II). The figure means students in the region missed more than a month of classroom instruction because of weather-related hazards and other disasters, based on data submitted by the Department of Education Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Service (DepEd DRRMS) as of May 5. philippines.title: NCAA: Letran opens 'redemption' bid with win over Perpetual Help
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines–Letran scraped past Perpetual Help, 84-77, to kick off action in Group B of the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday night at Mall of Asia Arena. The Knights, who lost the title to their fierce rivals San Beda Red Lions last season, began their “redemption season” with a rousing win over the Altas, a squad they eliminated in last year’s semifinals. “Coach Allen (Ricardo) and I have been saying that this season is about redemption,” said guard Jimboy Estrada in Filipino after dropping 18 points, six assists and four rebounds. philippines.description:
Award-winning movie “Filipiñana” has been selected as an official entry of the Philippines to the 99th Academy Awards, also known as the Oscars, along with two other films in separate categories. The Film Academy of the Philippines director general Paolo Villaluna made the announcement on Sunday at the SMX Convention Center where members of the entertainment press took their oaths as officers of the newly-formed press organization, LENTE.
